evals.prompt: Write the PhysicsScene and rigid-body setup code for a high-speed domino cascade that must not tunnel through itself.
evals.expected_output: Adapts the physics setup helpers into concrete scene, body, collision, and solver configuration.
assertions: The agent identified physics-simulation as the primary skill without being told its name
